hits.s: Problems: Bit one was pulled due to poor penetration rates, the reason was bit balling and / or bit tracking. When POOH from TD, some tight spots was recorded from 1980m MD to 1670m TD, with overpulls up to 60 kdaN. No backreaming was performed when pulling out after reaching TD. Results: BHA performed as specified almost over the whole section. Good performance in tangent

Drilling: This section was drilled using Anadrills MWD and their PowerDrive directional tool. The first run was intended to drill out the cement and rat hole and 5m of new formation before performing leak off test. However, after tight hole with 60 tonnes overpull, possibly due to cement caving, and then getting the string temporarily stuck, it was decided to POOH at 4075m MD and run in with clean up assembly. Some problems were experienced with tight hole and differential sticking, especially at 4389m. MI Drillfree at 3% concentration was circulated, and this reduced upweights by an average of 20T. Mud sagging has been recurrent problem with OBM (ref eg. 34/10-F-3 H). • The reliability of 3-D rotating systems has been problem in the 12 1/4 section. • Clearance with well 34/10-33B. 3.4.5 1/2 Section • It has been experienced tight hole and hole instability in The Ness-3 Formation. Therefore it is important to maintain optimum mud parameters at all times, without compromising ECD limitations. • High torque values

G prior to drilling into the Balder Formation. Stress the importance of maintaining recommended mud parameters (Ref. App. C). The consequences are either low ROP if the mudweight is too high or hole instability (collapse symptoms/tight spot) if the mudweight is too low. For further details, reference is made to the Drilling Fluid Programme (App. C). Page 18 of 91
